comparator.name: Bachelor in Philosophy of a Specific Discipline
comparator.sourceNotes: The 2026–2027 TER Article3.4 and Appendix2 establish a180EC degree:90EC recognised complementary discipline,60EC in eight named common philosophy courses,15EC discipline-specific philosophy and15EC thesis/milestones. The formal document directs current discipline-specific choices to MyEUR. The public overview is explicitly a2025–2026 guide and its ESE menu includes Class,Race and Gender,absent from the current formal menu. Current Rules and Guidelines do not resolve the current ESE allocation. Preserve only the independently verified60EC common philosophy and15EC thesis trajectory as named curriculum; the remaining105EC needs a concrete valid discipline pathway. No UCR no-match is inferred.
components: What Can We Know? Answers from Antiquity to Modern Age

audience.programmeDescription: This degree combines philosophical inquiry with another academic discipline. Students study common philosophy courses, philosophy related to their chosen discipline, and a thesis connecting the two fields.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The complete pathway is still being verified. The common philosophy and thesis requirements shown below are confirmed; the complementary discipline courses and current discipline-specific philosophy choices need clarification before a full UCR comparison can be approved.

curriculum.limitation: The degree comprises 180 EC. The displayed requirements account for 75 EC; the remaining 90 EC of complementary study and 15 EC of discipline-specific philosophy require a verified selection. Admission normally requires a completed 60-EC first year in another recognised Dutch university bachelor. The thesis trajectory requires 30 EC completed within this programme.
